# `music` — `/api/music`

Music Lab router — DB-backed instrument generation, asset library, and job tracking for the song-gen sidecar (ACE-Step / MusicGen).

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/music/assets`](#get-api-music-assets) | The Music Lab library, newest first, filtered by kind, instrument, favorite, project or source asset. |
| PATCH | [`/api/music/assets/{asset_id}`](#patch-api-music-assets-asset-id) | Rename an asset or mark it a favorite. |
| DELETE | [`/api/music/assets/{asset_id}`](#delete-api-music-assets-asset-id) | Remove an asset and its audio file. |
| GET | [`/api/music/assets/{asset_id}/audio`](#get-api-music-assets-asset-id-audio) | The asset's WAV file, named after its label. |
| POST | [`/api/music/assets/{asset_id}/regenerate`](#post-api-music-assets-asset-id-regenerate) | Re-submits the asset's stored params as a fresh job. |
| GET | [`/api/music/capabilities`](#get-api-music-capabilities) | Merge song-gen's dynamically-probed provider capabilities with the already-working Demucs stem-separation facts, so the frontend can disable an uninstalled/unavailable provider rather than failing at generate time. |
| POST | [`/api/music/generate`](#post-api-music-generate) | Instrument Generator. |
| POST | [`/api/music/jam`](#post-api-music-jam) | Provide either a fresh input_audio upload or an existing input_asset_id. |
| GET | [`/api/music/jobs`](#get-api-music-jobs) | Recent jobs (DB-backed, survives a backend restart, unlike tools.py's in-memory _jobs), annotated with gpu_queue position. |
| GET | [`/api/music/jobs/{job_id}`](#get-api-music-jobs-job-id) | A generation job's row, with its place in the GPU queue. |
| POST | [`/api/music/stems`](#post-api-music-stems) | Returns {job_id, source_asset_id} immediately. |

<a id="get-api-music-assets"></a>
### `GET /api/music/assets`

The Music Lab library, newest first, filtered by kind, instrument, favorite, project or source asset.

- Handler: [`list_assets`](../../../backend/routers/music.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | query | string or null | no |  |  |
| `instrument` | query | string or null | no |  |  |
| `favorite` | query | boolean or null | no |  |  |
| `project_id` | query | integer or null | no |  |  |
| `source_asset_id` | query | string or null | no |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list of rows of `music_assets`: `id`, `kind`, `provider`, `source_asset_id`, `label`, `instrument`, `prompt`, `params_json`, `file_path`, `duration_seconds`, `bpm`, `musical_key`, `favorite`, `project_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`

<a id="post-api-music-assets-asset-id-regenerate"></a>
### `POST /api/music/assets/{asset_id}/regenerate`

Re-submits the asset's stored params as a fresh job. Produces a new asset; never overwrites the original.

- Handler: [`regenerate_asset`](../../../backend/routers/music.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `job_id`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Asset has no recorded provider/params to regenerate from | `regenerate_asset` |
| 400 | Only song-gen results (generated/jam_response assets) can be regenerated — stems and recordings aren't produced by a provider call. | `regenerate_asset` |
| 404 | Asset not found | `_get_asset_or_404` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="get-api-music-capabilities"></a>
### `GET /api/music/capabilities`

Merge song-gen's dynamically-probed provider capabilities with the already-working Demucs stem-separation facts, so the frontend can disable an uninstalled/unavailable provider rather than failing at generate time.

- Handler: [`get_capabilities`](../../../backend/routers/music.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `providers`, `stems` (JSON object with `provider`, `sidecar_status`, `engines`, `stem_counts`)

| `provider` | string | yes |  |  |

| `instrument` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `genre` | string or null | no |  |  |

<a id="post-api-music-jam"></a>
### `POST /api/music/jam`

Provide either a fresh input_audio upload or an existing input_asset_id. Returns {job_id, source_asset_id}. The AI's response is always a separate asset (kind='jam_response'), never merged with the input.

- Handler: [`jam`](../../../backend/routers/music.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `multipart/form-data`, form)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | string | yes |  |  |
| `role` | string | yes |  |  |
| `style` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `bpm` | number or null | no |  |  |
| `key` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `duration_seconds` | number | no | `15.0` |  |
| `label` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `input_audio` | file or null | no |  |  |
| `input_asset_id` | string or null | no |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `job_id`, `source_asset_id`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Provide input_audio (upload) or input_asset_id (an existing asset) | `jam` |
| 400 | Unknown provider: {provider} | `jam` |
| 404 | Asset not found | `_get_asset_or_404` |
| 404 | Input asset audio not found | `jam` |
| 413 | {upload.filename or 'That file'} is over {limit // MB} MB, the most this accepts. | `_too_big` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="get-api-music-jobs"></a>
### `GET /api/music/jobs`

Recent jobs (DB-backed, survives a backend restart, unlike tools.py's in-memory _jobs), annotated with gpu_queue position.

- Handler: [`list_jobs`](../../../backend/routers/music.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `jobs` (JSON list, each item JSON object with the fields of a row of `music_generation_jobs`: `id`, `kind`, `provider`, `sidecar`, `status`, `progress`, `params_json`, `result_asset_id`, `error`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `queue_position`), `gpu_queue_depth`
